body_markdown:
**Las Vegas — Sept. 19, 2026** –


Beasley Media Group is proud to celebrate two longtime members of its Las Vegas team, Mande Dellinger and Ryan Hunter, who were inducted into the Nevada Broadcasters Association Hall of Fame during the organization’s 30th Hall of Fame Celebration on Saturday, Sept. 19, at Durango Casino & Resort in Las Vegas.


The Nevada Broadcasters Association Hall of Fame was established to recognize the dedication, talent and contributions of professionals who have built careers in radio and television. Inductees must have at least 20 years of experience in broadcasting, including a minimum of five years in Nevada. Dellinger and Hunter are among the broadcasters named to the Hall of Fame’s Class of 2026.


##### **Mande Dellinger**


Dellinger’s broadcasting career is closely connected to Beasley Media Group. After moving from Colorado to Las Vegas in 1998 to attend the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, she graduated in 2002 with a Bachelor of Arts in communications and began her professional career at Beasley as a national sales coordinator.


Over the years, Dellinger has taken on a wide variety of roles within the company, including:


- Executive assistant to Tom Humm


- Account executive


- National sales manager


- Regional AR captain


- Integrated sales/digital strategy manager


After more than 13 years with Beasley, Dellinger briefly stepped away from broadcasting before returning to the company in 2019. Her diverse career path and willingness to take on new challenges have made her a valued member of the Las Vegas team.


##### **Ryan Hunter**


Hunter has spent more than two decades building a career behind the microphone and connecting with Las Vegas listeners. Today, he serves as the weekend host on 96.3 KKLZ and afternoon drive host on 107.9 Coyote Country.


Known for his energetic delivery and commitment to keeping his shows local, Hunter focuses on creating content that reflects the Las Vegas community. His broadcasting career also extends beyond radio. Hunter has worked in television behind the scenes as both an engineer and narrator.


The Nevada Broadcasters Association created its Hall of Fame to honor professionals whose passion, talent and long-term commitment have helped shape Nevada broadcasting.


Beasley Media Group congratulates Mande Dellinger and Ryan Hunter on this well-deserved recognition and celebrates their continued contributions to the company, the Las Vegas community and Nevada broadcasting.
